local({
  wave <- as.character(.wave)
  replaced <- case_when(
    wave == "2009" ~ as.numeric(Q2B01P01) != as.numeric(Q2B01P01I) | as.numeric(Q2B01P02) != as.numeric(Q2B01P02I),
    wave == "2015_sample_2" ~ as.numeric(VB17005) %in% 1,
    .default = FALSE
  )
  weight <- case_when(
    wave == "2009" & !as.numeric(Q2B01P01) %in% 888 ~ as.numeric(Q2B01P01),
    wave == "2015_sample_2" & !as.numeric(VB17001) %in% c(998, 9999) ~ as.numeric(VB17001) / 10,
    .default = NA_real_
  )
  height <- case_when(
    wave == "2009" & !as.numeric(Q2B01P02) %in% 888 ~ as.numeric(Q2B01P02) / 100,
    wave == "2015_sample_2" & !as.numeric(VB17002) %in% c(998, 9999) ~ as.numeric(VB17002) / 1000,
    .default = NA_real_
  )
  if_else(replaced %in% TRUE, NA_real_, weight / height^2)
})
